 Tyler Perry Purchases Puerto Rico Home For $30 Million
 Tyler Perry 
 Officially on Island Time ... 
 Buys $30 Million Puerto Rico Home 
 Exclusive 
 Add TMZ on Google 
 By TMZ Staff 
 Published 
 October 17, 2026
 11:01 AM PDT 
 Gallery 
 Launch Gallery 
 HOME SWEET HOME 
 Launch Gallery
 Gallery 
 Getty Composite 
 Madea may soon pop up in Puerto Rico ... because Tyler Perry bought a massive mansion on the island -- and TMZ has learned he plans to shoot some projects down there.
 Sources confirm to TMZ ... the movie mogul has just closed on a $30 million, 14,475-square-foot home which sits on nearly 1.4 acres of land.
 The 5-bedroom, 10-bathroom home was built in 2021 and sits in a gated community on the island.
 Tyler's new digs feature a movie theater, an open-concept kitchen, a pool, and a gym.
 Getty 
 It'll be a nice place for Tyler to unwind after a long workday... and we've learned he does plan to work while he's down in the Caribbean -- our sources say he's opening a production office and will shoot shows on the island ... but don't worry, his Atlanta studios are still up and running.
 Tyler's just the latest celeb to move down to PR in recent years ... Logan and Jake Paul live on the island now -- and celebs like Paul Rudd and Mariska Hargitay have been spotted vacationing down there as well.
 There might not be a ton of soundstages in Puerto Rico ... but it sounds like Tyler's house is big enough to accommodate any of his set needs!
